criteria.text: Clicking an existing task anywhere (Weekly Planner, Tasks, Dashboard) opens the inspector already in edit mode — title/notes/dates are immediately editable with Save/Cancel visible, no "Edit details" click required.
criteria.test_id: issue-675-c1: inspector opens in edit mode by default (Save/Cancel visible, no Edit details click required)

criteria.text: Calendar shadow-event tasks (sourceType == 'calendar_shadow_event') remain non-editable (read-only gate preserved).

criteria.text: In the Weekly Planner, the day-column "Add task" opens the full inspector in edit mode, pre-seeded with that day as the scheduled date; saving creates the task on that day (with the companion backend fix landed).
criteria.test_id: issue-675-c3: day-column create inspector seeds the selected day and saving creates with that scheduledDate

criteria.text: The backlog "Add unscheduled task" opens the same inspector with no scheduled date; saving creates a backlog task.
criteria.test_id: issue-675-c4: backlog create inspector has no scheduled date and saving creates a backlog task

criteria.text: Notes, due date, preferred agent, and (where applicable) collaborators can be set during creation, not just title/owner.
criteria.test_id: issue-675-c5: notes, due date, and preferred agent are settable during creation; collaborator controls hidden for unsaved task

criteria.text: Cancel discards a new task without creating it.
